result:
This all looks correct and verified via build. Here's a summary of what I found and fixed.

## What was wrong

The product rebranded from **InboxZap** (email cleanup) to **Lumina** (AI meeting assistant), but the SEO/content layer never caught up:

1. **Stale metadata**: `app/layout.tsx`'s title/description/OG tags still described InboxZap's email-cleanup pitch, completely mismatched with the actual product.
2. **Missing pages**: `/features` and `/pricing` were linked in nav and the sitemap but didn't exist in the repo at all.
3. **Broken blog**: `app/blog/page.tsx` was a client component fetching `/api/posts` — a route that doesn't exist (404s), so the blog index rendered "Could not load posts" to users and crawlers.
4. **100% irrelevant legacy content**: all 12 existing blog posts were old InboxZap articles ("Bulk Delete Emails," "Gmail Storage Full," etc.) — zero topical relevance to a meeting assistant. GSC confirms this content is dead weight: thousands of impressions but position 40-60 and near-zero clicks, and it was actively excluded from the sitemap.
5. **Wasted branded demand**: GSC shows people still searching "inboxzap"/"inboxzap app"/"inboxzap review" and clicking through at a decent position (~4-9, real CTR) — but landing on a totally different product with no explanation, which likely just confuses and bounces them.
6. **Broken `/faq` redirect**: `next.config.js` redirected `/faq` → `/#faq`, but no `#faq` section existed on the homepage.

## What I changed

- **`app/layout.tsx`** — corrected title/description/OG/Twitter metadata to Lumina, added `metadataBase`, and added Organization + SoftwareApplication JSON-LD.
- **`app/features/page.tsx`**, **`app/pricing/page.tsx`** (new) — built out with proper per-page metadata.
- **`app/page.tsx`** — added a real `#faq` section (fixing the dead redirect) that explicitly answers "What happened to InboxZap?" to capture and convert that existing branded search traffic, plus FAQPage JSON-LD.
- **`app/blog/posts.ts`** (new) — replaced the dead email-cleanup topics with 3 posts aligned to actual buyer intent for an AI meeting assistant (how-to, educational, and a comparison/commercial-intent post).
- **`app/blog/page.tsx`** — rewritten as a server component listing real posts (no more broken client fetch).
- **`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`** (new) — statically generated post pages with per-post metadata + Article JSON-LD.
- **`app/sitemap.ts`** — now includes all blog posts (resolved the old TODO).
- **`next.config.js`** — added a 301 redirect for all legacy `/blog/post-:id` URLs to `/blog`, so their residual crawl signal funnels into the current site instead of dead-ending on irrelevant content.

Verified with `npx next build` — compiles clean, all pages and posts statically generate, no warnings.
